harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Persistently disabled ICMP redirect acceptance and IPv4 source-routed packet acceptance on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf, verified live and after two reboots (boot_id changed each time, confirming genuine restarts).
actions_performed: Checked baseline sysctl values: accept_redirects=1 (all/default), accept_source_route already 0
Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf setting accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0 for all/default
Applied with sysctl --system and verified runtime values
Discovered eth0 interface retained accept_redirects=1 despite all/default=0 (per-interface override); added explicit eth0 entries and lo entry to the config, reapplied
Captured boot_id baseline, rebooted node1 via 'shutdown -r now' in background so ack returned before disconnect, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed
Found lo interface reverted to accept_redirects=1 post-reboot because it wasn't yet persisted; added net.ipv4.conf.lo.accept_redirects=0 to the sysctl file and reapplied

Performed a second reboot to validate the corrected config persists fully across restart; confirmed boot_id changed again and all four settings (accept_redirects, accept_source_route on all/default/eth0/lo) read 0

evidence.requirement: Persistent config file created and applied
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf and applied with sysctl --system, showing new values loaded
Detected eth0 accept_redirects still 1 after all/default set to 0, applied and persisted eth0-specific override, verified all interfaces at 0

evidence.requirement: Boot identity baseline and first restart proof
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 15443601..., issued reboot (ack returned), node briefly unreachable, reconnected with new boot_id 08f9094d... and new uptime -s, proving restart

evidence.requirement: Post-restart settings check surfaced lo regression, fixed and persisted
evidence.summary: lo.accept_redirects reverted to 1 after reboot; added lo entry to sysctl.d file and reapplied, confirmed 0

evidence.requirement: Second restart proof and final persistence verification
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 08f9094d... pre-reboot, issued second reboot, node unreachable then reconnected with changed boot_id 4b9f3de9..., and all/default/eth0/lo accept_redirects and accept_source_route confirmed 0 across the board, with config file contents verified
